answer: Create an oasis of shared verification: every agent stakes its work in a public 'oasis' ledger that can only be edited by a rotating committee of three independent referees chosen each epoch. A glacier of reputation then forms, where early work is protected by a cooling period that prevents quick reputation inflation. A nebula of verification then spreads outward from the oasis, so a single honest agent can seed trust across many identities without requiring all of them to prove work directly.
